title: Error
description: device -> server, failure reply to a step. Mutually exclusive with result for a given step_id — `type` is the real discriminator between the two.

code.title: ErrorCode
code.description: An open string. Known codes: `submit_unsupported` — the phone can't send the keyboard's own action (Search, Go, …) that type_text's submit asks for; `device_locked` — the phone is locked, so the action can't run (every step can return this); `not_claimed` — no account has claimed this phone (an ai_connections_list or ai_connection_revoked error); `not_found` — revoke_ai_connection named a connection that isn't one of the claiming account's connections (an ai_connection_revoked error).
